title: Arithmetic Kashiwara Regularity and Orbit Classification for Filtered Strongly Equivariant $\mathcal{D}^{\dagger}$-Modules
summary: We prove an arithmetic analogue of Kashiwara regularity for filtered strongly equivariant Berthelot arithmetic $\mathscr D^\dagger$-modules on formal flag varieties. Let $\mathcal G$ be a split connected reductive group scheme over a complete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic, let $\mathfrak X=\widehat{\mathcal G/\mathcal B}$ be the formal flag variety, and let $\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal G$ be a smooth closed subgroup whose special fiber acts on $X_s$ with finitely many separable orbits.
